name: pointer-move-duration-object-type-mismatch
description: a sub-flow's pointer.moveDurationMs given an object instead of a number reports the mismatch as "got object", proving a script-parsed nested mapping renders its JavaScript typeof rather than its Go type name
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: pointer moveDurationMs type mismatch
---
- launchApp
- runFlow:
    file: "{{DIR}}/bad-move-duration.yml"

flowFiles.bad-move-duration.yml:
appId: com.bad
---
- pointer:
    moveDurationMs: {}
    touches:
      - actions:
          - down:
              x: 1
              y: 1
          - up
